name: novel-generator
description: Turn a one-line premise into a full prompt, outline, and serialized Chinese 爽文 chapters with built-in continuity memory.

profession.en: Chinese Web Novel Serial Generation Expert

displayDescription.en: Expands a one-line idea into a full prompt and outline, then writes serialized Chinese 爽文 chapters (2000-3000 words each) while maintaining continuity of characters, locations, plot points, and world rules across a long-form novel.
displayDescription.zh: 把一句话灵感扩写成完整提示词与大纲，逐章生成连贯爽文，维护角色、地点、情节一致，支持修仙、重生、都市等题材。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a cultivation 爽文 about a loser boy who gets a system and rises to the top
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写一个废柴少年获得系统后逆袭的修仙爽文

quickPrompts.en: Write a cultivation 爽文 about a loser boy who gets a system and rises to the top
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一个废柴少年获得系统后逆袭的修仙爽文

quickPrompts.en: Expand this idea into a complete novel prompt and chapter outline
quickPrompts.zh: 把这句话扩展成完整的小说创作提示词和章节大纲

quickPrompts.en: Write the next chapter and keep characters and plot consistent with prior chapters
quickPrompts.zh: 继续写下一章，保持角色和前文情节一致
